# Kanwar Arcade: full guide

Kanwar Arcade is a free collection of browser games made by Kanwar Afaq. Games run in any modern browser with no download, account or advertising. Best scores are stored in the browser's local storage and never sent anywhere.

## Starfall (Space shooter)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/starfall.html
Starfall is a free space shooter you can play in your browser. Dodge, shoot, grab power-ups and beat the boss.
Controls: Steer with arrow keys, the mouse or your finger. Fire with Space, a click or a tap.
Mouse or touch: drag to steer. Press and hold to fire, or turn on auto-fire.
- ←→↑↓: Move
- WASD: Move
- Space: Fire (hold)
- F: Auto-fire on or off
- P: Pause
- M: Mute
Tips:
- Power-ups drop from ships: R is rapid fire, T is triple shot, S is a shield and + is an extra life.
- Destroy ships in quick succession to raise your multiplier to x5. A hit or a missed ship resets it.
- A boss arrives every fourth wave. Keep moving and keep firing.
FAQ:
Q: How do you play Starfall?
A: Steer your ship with the arrow keys, the mouse or your finger and fire with Space or a tap. Shoot falling ships, collect power-ups and beat the boss every fourth wave.
Q: Is Starfall free to play?
A: Yes. It runs in your browser with no download, no account and no ads.

## Brick Rally (Brick breaker)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/brick-rally.html
Brick Rally is a free brick-breaker you can play in your browser. Five levels, power-ups and a streak multiplier.
Controls: Move the paddle with the mouse, your finger or arrow keys. Launch with Space or a tap.
Mouse or touch: slide to move the paddle. Click or tap to launch.
- ←→: Move paddle
- AD: Move paddle
- Space: Launch the ball
- P: Pause
- M: Mute
Tips:
- Hit the ball with the edge of the paddle to send it off at a sharper angle.
- Grey bricks never break. Clear every other brick to finish the level.
- Power-ups drop from bricks: W is a wide paddle, M is multi-ball, S slows the ball and + is an extra life.
- Break bricks without touching the paddle to build a multiplier of up to x4.
FAQ:
Q: How do you play Brick Rally?
A: Slide the paddle with the mouse, your finger or the arrow keys and launch the ball with Space or a tap. Break every brick to clear the level.
Q: How many levels does Brick Rally have?
A: Five levels, with power-ups such as a wide paddle, multi-ball and slow ball.

## Serpentine (Snake game)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/serpentine.html
Serpentine is a free snake game for your browser with smooth glowing graphics, combo fruit and rocks to dodge. Play with arrow keys or swipe.
Controls: Steer with the arrow keys or swipe on the board.
Touch or mouse: swipe or drag on the board to turn.
- ←→↑↓: Steer
- WASD: Steer
- Space: Start or resume
- P: Pause
- M: Mute
- N: Music on or off
Tips:
- Eat fruit quickly one after another to build a combo multiplier.
- Walls, rocks and your own tail all end the run, so leave yourself room to turn.
- Plan your route a few cells ahead. The snake speeds up as it grows.
FAQ:
Q: How do you play Serpentine?
A: Steer the snake with the arrow keys, WASD or a swipe. Eat fruit to grow and score, and avoid walls, rocks and your own tail.
Q: Does Serpentine work on a phone?
A: Yes. Swipe on the board to turn. The game scales to fit any screen.

## Skyhop (One-tap flyer)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/skyhop.html
Skyhop is a free one-tap flying game for your browser. Flap through gaps, collect stars and fly from sunrise into the night.
Controls: Tap, click or press Space to flap.
Touch or mouse: tap or click anywhere to flap.
- Space: Flap
- ↑ or W: Flap
- P: Pause
- M: Mute
- N: Music on or off
Tips:
- Short, steady taps keep you level better than frantic ones.
- Stars are worth grabbing, but a clean line through the gap matters more.
- The sky changes from dawn to night as you go. Keep going to see every zone.
FAQ:
Q: How do you play Skyhop?
A: Tap, click or press Space to flap. Fly through the gaps, collect stars and avoid the obstacles.
Q: Is Skyhop free?
A: Yes. It is free, runs in your browser and needs no download or sign-up.

## Lightmerge (Puzzle game)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/lightmerge.html
Lightmerge is a free 2048-style sliding puzzle for your browser. Merge matching tiles, chase combos and reach 2048. Play with arrow keys or swipe.
Controls: Slide the tiles with the arrow keys, WASD or a swipe.
Touch or mouse: swipe on the board to slide every tile.
- ←→↑↓: Slide tiles
- WASD: Slide tiles
- Space: Start or resume
- P: Pause
- M: Mute
- N: Music on or off
Tips:
- Keep your biggest tile in a corner and build a chain of smaller tiles beside it.
- Stick to two or three directions. Sliding the opposite way can scatter your chain.
- Every move adds a new tile, so merge often to keep room on the board.
FAQ:
Q: How do you play Lightmerge?
A: Slide all tiles in one direction with the arrow keys, WASD or a swipe. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one with double the value. Reach 2048 to win.
Q: Is Lightmerge the same as 2048?
A: It follows the same sliding-tile idea, with its own glowing look, sound and effects. Everything runs in your browser.

## Driftrock (Asteroid shooter)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/driftrock.html
Driftrock is a free neon asteroid shooter for your browser. Fly, shoot and survive waves of splitting rocks. Play with the keyboard, mouse or touch.
Controls: Turn with A and D, thrust with W and shoot with Space.
Mouse or touch: press and hold to aim and shoot. Hold farther from the ship to thrust.
- AD or ←→: Turn
- W or ↑: Thrust
- Space: Shoot (hold)
- P: Pause
- M: Mute
- N: Music on or off
Tips:
- Large rocks split into two medium ones, and medium rocks split into small, fast ones.
- Your ship keeps drifting, so thrust in short bursts and use the screen edges to wrap around.
- You earn an extra life every 5,000 points and a bonus for clearing each wave.
FAQ:
Q: How do you play Driftrock?
A: Turn with A and D or the arrow keys, thrust with W and hold Space to shoot. Every rock you hit splits into smaller pieces. Clear them all to start the next wave.
Q: Does Driftrock work on a phone?
A: Yes. Press and hold on the screen to aim and fire, and hold away from the ship to thrust.

## Lumenfall (3D adventure)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/lumenfall.html
Lumenfall is a free 3D adventure that runs in your browser. Explore Crystal Valley, fight enemies, find nine energy crystals and reach the final portal.
Controls: Move with WASD, look with the mouse, jump with Space and attack with a click.
Lumenfall needs a keyboard and mouse, so it is built for desktop and laptop browsers.
- WASD: Move
- Mouse: Look around
- Shift: Run
- Space: Jump
- Click: Attack
- Esc: Pause
Tips:
- Collect all nine glowing crystals to open the final portal.
- Watch your health bar. Enemies hit harder as you go deeper into the realm.
- Check the mini-map in the corner to find crystals you have missed.
FAQ:
Q: Can I play Lumenfall on my phone?
A: Lumenfall uses a keyboard and mouse with pointer lock, so it works best on a desktop or laptop in a current browser.
Q: What do I need to run Lumenfall?
A: A recent browser with WebGL 2. The first load downloads a few megabytes of game code and the character model.

## Neon Velocity (3D racing game)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/neon-velocity.html
Neon Velocity is a free 3D arcade racer for your browser. Pick a car, race three rivals over three laps, drift corners and burn your nitro.
Controls: Steer with A and D, accelerate with W, drift with Space and use nitro with Shift.
Neon Velocity needs a keyboard, so it is built for desktop and laptop browsers.
- WASD: Drive
- Space: Drift
- Shift: Nitro boost
- C: Change camera
- Esc: Pause
Tips:
- Stay on the glowing road. Driving on the grass slows you right down.
- Hold Space while turning to drift. Drift score builds the longer you slide at speed.
- Save nitro for the straight after a corner, and avoid bumping rivals because it costs you speed.
FAQ:
Q: How do you play Neon Velocity?
A: Press W to accelerate, steer with A and D, hold Space to drift and Shift for a nitro boost. Beat three rivals over the laps to finish first.
Q: Can I play Neon Velocity on my phone?
A: No. It needs a keyboard, so it works best on a desktop or laptop in a current browser.

## Starfall Protocol (3D shooter)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/starfall-protocol.html
Starfall Protocol is a free 3D top-down shooter for your browser. Activate the orbital relay, clear the hostiles, dodge fire with a dash and take down the Reactor Sentinel.
Controls: Move with WASD, aim with the mouse, click to fire, press Q to dash, 1 to 3 to switch weapons and hold E at the terminal.
Starfall Protocol needs a keyboard and mouse, so it is built for desktop and laptop browsers.
- WASD: Move
- Mouse: Aim and fire
- Q: Dash
- 123: Blaster, plasma, pulse
- E: Hold to activate the relay
- Esc: Pause
Tips:
- Walk to the amber terminal first and hold E. Enemies wake up as you get close, so clear a path first if it gets busy.
- Dash with Q to slip through enemy fire. Your shield recharges when you stay out of danger.
- Switch weapons to suit the fight. Plasma hits hard but drains energy, and the pulse gun spreads three shots.
FAQ:
Q: How do you play Starfall Protocol?
A: Move with WASD and aim with the mouse. Hold E at the terminal to restore the relay, clear every hostile, then destroy the Reactor Sentinel.
Q: Can I play Starfall Protocol on my phone?
A: No. It needs a keyboard and mouse, so it works best on a desktop or laptop in a current browser.

## Aether Run (Neon hover racer)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/aether-run.html
Aether Run is a neon hover-racing browser game with a procedural skyline, glowing light trails, collectable energy rings, and atmospheric sound effects.
Controls: Steer with A and D or arrows. Hold Shift to boost; mobile touch controls are included.

FAQ:
Q: How do you play Aether Run?
A: Steer around red barriers, collect blue energy rings and hold boost to go faster.
Q: Is Aether Run playable on a phone?
A: Yes. The game has touch steering and boost controls.

## Moonlit Grove (Fantasy survival)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/moonlit-grove.html
Moonlit Grove is a fantasy survival browser game featuring an enchanted sanctuary, spellcasting, glowing particles, progressive enemy waves and original synth sound effects.
Controls: Move with WASD or arrows, aim with the pointer and dash with Space or Shift. Touch controls included.
undefined

Tips:

FAQ:
Q: How do you play Moonlit Grove?
A: Move through the enchanted grove, aim with the mouse or touch, cast automatic spells and dash away from shadow enemies.
Q: Is Moonlit Grove free?
A: Yes, it runs entirely in your browser with no installation.

## Park Dash (Kids running race)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/park-dash.html
Park Dash is an animated kids running racing game with four rival runners, lanes, jumps, stars, sprinting and a 1500-meter finish line. No cars or scooters.
Controls: Use arrows or A/D to change lanes, Space to jump, Shift to sprint. Touch controls included.
undefined

Tips:

FAQ:
Q: How do you play Park Dash?
A: Race on foot against three kid rivals. Jump hurdles, dodge puddles, collect stars and sprint to the finish.
Q: Are there cars or scooters?
A: No. Park Dash is only a running race between kids on foot.

## Serpent Studio (Customizable snake)
URL: https://games-psi-ashy.vercel.app/games/serpent-studio.html
Serpent Studio offers Classic, Zen, 90-second Sprint and Maze modes, three speed settings, four skins, glowing graphics and separate mode high scores.
Controls: Choose Classic, Zen, Sprint or Maze; steer with arrows, WASD or swipes. Customize speed and appearance.
undefined

Tips:

FAQ:
Q: What modes does Serpent Studio offer?
A: Classic, Zen with wraparound, timed Sprint and Maze obstacles.
Q: Can I customize difficulty and colors?
A: Yes, choose three speeds and four skins before starting.

## General FAQ
Q: What is Kanwar Arcade?
A: Kanwar Arcade is a free collection of 13 browser games: Starfall, Brick Rally, Serpentine, Skyhop, Lightmerge, Driftrock, Lumenfall, Neon Velocity, Starfall Protocol, Aether Run, Moonlit Grove, Park Dash, Serpent Studio. They run in any modern browser with no download, no account and no ads.
Q: Are the games really free?
A: Yes. Every game is free, there are no in-app purchases and nothing to install.
Q: Do the games work on a phone?
A: Starfall, Brick Rally, Serpentine, Skyhop, Lightmerge, Driftrock, Aether Run, Moonlit Grove, Park Dash, Serpent Studio work with touch as well as keyboard and mouse. Lumenfall and Neon Velocity and Starfall Protocol are 3D games that need a keyboard, so they are best on a desktop or laptop.
Q: Where are my high scores saved?
A: Best scores are saved in your own browser with local storage. They never leave your device and there is no account to make.
Q: Which game should I try first?
A: Try Starfall for fast action, Skyhop for a one-tap challenge, Lightmerge for a puzzle, Park Dash for kids running, Serpent Studio for customizable snake, Aether Run for neon hover racing, Moonlit Grove for fantasy survival, Lumenfall for a 3D adventure, Neon Velocity for racing and Starfall Protocol for a 3D shooter.
